stem: Meena, a 13-year-old student in Pune, is making a plan for healthy growth during adolescence. Which plan is best for her?

options.text: Eat only her favourite filling snack each day, since one tasty food gives all the nutrients she needs
Eat balanced meals with proteins, carbohydrates, fats, vitamins and minerals, and play outdoor games regularly
Eat balanced meals but stop all exercise, because good food alone keeps the body healthy
Choose sweets and soft drinks instead of regular meals, and keep exercising to make up for it

teacher.key_rationale: Adolescence requires a nutritious diet containing all major nutrient groups together with regular physical activity; only option B includes both. Options A and D fail on nutrition, C drops the exercise condition.
